description: The Vault pair: F-9 COPY CORRECTION ONLY (a paid customer is never told to pay again - the identical refusal string at BOTH core/secure-files/handler.py:1460 in _redeem and :1225 in _redeem_after_reconcile) and F-10 (a native Vault purchase that delivered neither a link nor a file stops reporting VAULT_READY and returns VAULT_DELIVERY_DEFERRED with an ordered reason enum). Grouped as the two Vault-delivery fixes; they touch different functions (wecare-secure-files and wecare-whatsapp-business-api) and are independent of each other, so order within the FEAT does not matter - but F-9's copy half is the higher-value one because it is the only LIVE residue, reachable today through the ungated native chain. Two commits, one per F-item. Corresponds to plan.md Part A items 7 and 8. CRITICAL SCOPE BOUNDARY: the F-9 RE-ISSUE ROUTE is STOP (plan.md Part B row B8) and must NOT be implemented, tested or stubbed - no reissue query parameter, no REISSUE_CAP, no reissueCount, no conditional update, no _customer_list REDEEMED_REISSUABLE arm, and no tests/test_vault_download_reissue.py. F-10's deploy rides with design.md 5 item 8, which is STOP.
steps: STEP 0 - read context.json and this file FIRST, then plan.md Part A items 7 and 8 and Part B rows B5/B7/B8. Re-derive every anchor on the merged tree; FEAT-001's findings win over plan.md's numbers where they differ.

F-9 STEP 1 - re-derive: `git grep -n 'Please pay again to download' -- amplify/functions/core/secure-files/handler.py` must return EXACTLY TWO hits (at the anchor: :1225 and :1460). If it returns two hits at :1210/:1441 instead, FEAT-001's merge did not land and you must stop. Confirm the two enclosing functions with `git grep -n '^def _redeem' -- <same>`: _redeem_after_reconcile at :1191 and _redeem at :1405.

F-9 STEP 2 - replace the message at BOTH sites. From: "This download link is not valid. Please pay again to download." To: "This download link is no longer valid. If you have already paid, do not pay again; contact us to restore access." The replacement wording is DECIDED, not open: it follows the repository's established house copy for exactly this situation - src/components/VaultFilePurchase.tsx:59 ("This file is already paid. Contact us to restore access; please do not pay again.") and src/pages/checkout/success.tsx:61 ("If you have paid, do not pay again."), with src/pages/checkout/status.tsx:47 recording that "Do not pay again" is load-bearing copy.

F-9 STEP 3 - NOTHING ELSE CHANGES. The HTTP status stays 403. The error code stays GRANT_NOT_REDEEMABLE. The ConditionalCheckFailedException arms, the _reconcile_grant attempt at :1453, the `consumed = :false` single-use condition at :1428-1431, and the 60-second DOWNLOAD_URL_TTL (:215) are all untouched. No route, no query parameter, no reissueCount, no cap, no _customer_list arm, no TTL is created, extended or touched. Do not weaken the forwarded-link defence: _owned_active_file (:948-960) and the grant customerId check (:1421) stay exactly as they are.

F-9 STEP 4 - BOTH sites are required, and here is why the unreachable one matters. :1225 is NOT live-reachable today - _redeem_after_reconcile is entered only when _reconcile_grant returns True (:1453-1454), and that function returns False while _payment_enabled() is false (:1156-1157). But it becomes reachable the moment design.md 5 item 8 opens SECURE_FILES_PAYMENT_ENABLED, and item 8 lists F-9 as SATISFIED. Fixing one site only would open the gate onto the identical sentence with F-9 recorded as done. DO NOT open SECURE_FILES_PAYMENT_ENABLED to reach :1225 - the test is a source-level assertion precisely so the gate stays closed.

F-9 STEP 5 - write the two tests in the EXISTING tests/test_secure_files.py (1371 lines), following that file's established per-function source-body idiom: see test_redeem_after_reconcile_is_still_single_use (:860-863) and test_redeem_requires_paid_and_unconsumed (:196-200), both of which slice the handler source with source.split('def _redeem_after_reconcile')[1].split('\ndef ')[0]. (a) test_a_paid_customer_is_never_told_to_pay_again - assert "Please pay again to download" not in source, AND "do not pay again" in body for the _redeem body AND the _redeem_after_reconcile body independently. Totality over both sites, which is the invariant; fails today at both. (b) test_the_redeem_refusal_contract_is_unchanged - the sensitivity proof that this was copy and nothing else: for each of the two bodies assert "GRANT_NOT_REDEEMABLE" in body and "403" in body, and that "consumed = :false" and "paid = :true" still appear in the _redeem_after_reconcile body.

F-9 STEP 6 - no existing test asserts the old string, verified at planning time (`git grep -n 'pay again' -- tests` returns no assertion on it and `git grep -l 'GRANT_NOT_REDEEMABLE' -- tests` returns nothing), so this item breaks no test and adds the first pin on the invariant. Run tests/test_secure_files.py and tests/test_dropdocs_vault_no_second_charge.py, then the whole suite. Commit F-9 with its tests, staging exact paths only: amplify/functions/core/secure-files/handler.py, tests/test_secure_files.py.

F-10 STEP 1 - re-derive: `git grep -n '86400' -- amplify/functions/messaging/whatsapp-business-api/flows/paid_vault.py` (the compound condition, :103) and `git grep -n 'VAULT_READY' -- <same>` (the return, :113). At the anchor the document branch is :103-109 and the review send is :110-112. If you see :78 and :88, FEAT-001's merge did not land and you must stop.

F-10 STEP 2 - understand the defect before editing. The ready template at :91 is wecare_share_pdf, which has an IMAGE header and carries no URL button and no file parameter; the link-bearing wecare_default_download at :93-95 is behind VAULT_DYNAMIC_DOWNLOAD_TEMPLATE_ENABLED, which is absent everywhere and STAYS CLOSED. The document itself is a separate non-template message gated at :103 on `deliverable == 'pdf'` AND `deliveryKey` AND the 24-hour customer-service window. When that compound condition is false the branch is skipped entirely, execution falls to the review send at :110-112, and :113 returns VAULT_READY - a success outcome for a purchase that delivered neither a link nor a file.

F-10 STEP 3 - track whether the document branch was taken, and when the download-template flag is off AND the branch was not taken, return VAULT_DELIVERY_DEFERRED instead of VAULT_READY, logging vault_delivery_deferred with the requestId and a reason - NO filename, NO phone, NO fileId. The review send at :110-112 STILL HAPPENS: the customer did buy something, and suppressing the review nudge would hide the problem further. Only the OUTCOME changes. VAULT_REVIEW_PENDING (returned when `accepted` is false) is unchanged.

F-10 STEP 4 - THE REASON ENUM HAS A BINDING EVALUATION ORDER, FIRST MATCH WINS, mirroring :103's own left-to-right evaluation so the reported reason is always the FIRST clause that actually failed: `if file.get('deliverable') != 'pdf': reason = 'not_deliverable'` / `elif not file.get('deliveryKey'): reason = 'no_delivery_key'` / `else: reason = 'window_closed'`. The two file-shape reasons are permanent data problems needing a fix; window_closed is a timing problem a re-send can resolve, and it is LAST because it is the only one that can be true while the file is perfectly deliverable. Reporting a permanent problem as a timing one would send an operator down the wrong path.

F-10 STEP 5 - paid_vault.py has no logger today (it imports os, json, time, datetime, boto3, customer_auth, vault_access). Add `from lambda_utils.logging import get_logger, log_event` and `logger = get_logger(__name__)` at module scope and emit via log_event - the same house helper FEAT-003's F-6 adopts. If FEAT-003 already added these lines to this file, do not duplicate them.

F-10 STEP 6 - part (b), documentation: record in docs/whatsapp/native-catalog-release-status.md that opening WHATSAPP_CATALOG_SERVICES_ENABLED for Vault REQUIRES VAULT_DYNAMIC_DOWNLOAD_TEMPLATE_ENABLED in the same change, because wecare_share_pdf carries no link. DOCUMENTATION ONLY - DO NOT OPEN EITHER FLAG. Do not disturb catalog_service_checkout.meta_ready:91-106, which already refuses native checkout unless wecare_default_download is APPROVED with that exact button (:98-101); readiness is proven before the flag can open, and readiness and use are simply decoupled today.

F-10 STEP 7 - write tests/test_paid_vault_deferred_delivery.py, four cases, reusing tests/test_paid_vault.py's vault_env fixture (which already seeds a file with deliverable 'pdf' and a deliveryKey). (a) test_a_paid_vault_purchase_outside_the_window_is_not_reported_ready - deliverable 'pdf', deliveryKey set, contact['lastInboundMessageAt'] 25 HOURS old, flag absent; assert the outcome is VAULT_DELIVERY_DEFERRED, that EXACTLY ONE template send occurred (the share template) plus the review send, that NO document message was sent, and that vault_delivery_deferred was logged with reason == 'window_closed' and no filename. Today it returns VAULT_READY. With the order above this assertion is deterministic rather than accidental: the fixture passes clauses 1 and 2, so window_closed is the only reachable reason. (b) test_a_purchase_inside_the_window_is_still_ready - the sensitivity proof. (c) test_a_non_pdf_reports_not_deliverable - deliverable 'docx' with a STALE window; reason == 'not_deliverable', proving the file-shape reason wins over the timing one. (d) test_a_missing_delivery_key_reports_no_delivery_key - deliverable 'pdf', deliveryKey absent, stale window; reason == 'no_delivery_key'.

F-10 STEP 8 - run the new file plus tests/test_paid_vault.py and confirm every pre-existing case in the latter still passes UNCHANGED, then the whole suite. Commit F-10 with its tests, staging exact paths only: amplify/functions/messaging/whatsapp-business-api/flows/paid_vault.py, docs/whatsapp/native-catalog-release-status.md, tests/test_paid_vault_deferred_delivery.py.

FINAL STEP - set this FEAT's status to completed and record in findings: the whole-suite count after each commit, both commit SHAs, explicit confirmation that the F-9 re-issue route was NOT implemented and that no gate or flag was opened, and the exact new copy string so the reviewer can check it against both sites.
